title: Attention Is All You Need
abstract: We propose a new simple network architecture, the Transformer, based solely on attention mechanisms.

title: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding
abstract: We introduce a new language representation model called BERT.

title: Language Models are Few-Shot Learners
abstract: Recent work has demonstrated substantial gains on many NLP tasks by pre-training on a large corpus of text.
key_findings: Demonstrated scaling laws and zero-shot performance of GPT-3.

title: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition
abstract: We present a residual learning framework to ease the training of very deep networks.

title: Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models
abstract: We present high quality image synthesis results using diffusion probabilistic models.

title: LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models
abstract: We propose Low-Rank Adaptation, or LoRA, which freezes the pre-trained model weights and injects trainable rank decomposition matrices.

title: LLaMA: Open and Efficient Foundation Language Models
abstract: We introduce LLaMA, a collection of foundation language models ranging from 7B to 65B parameters.
key_findings: Released highly capable open-weight language models.

title: Evaluating Large Language Models Trained on Code
abstract: We introduce Codex, a GPT language model fine-tuned on publicly available code.
key_findings: Demonstrated the capabilities of language models for automated code generation.

title: Neural Machine Translation by Jointly Learning to Align and Translate
abstract: We propose a novel attention mechanism for neural machine translation.
key_findings: Introduced the attention mechanism in neural networks.

title: Training language models to follow instructions with human feedback
abstract: We show an avenue for aligning language models with user intent via RLHF.

title: Efficient Estimation of Word Representations in Vector Space
abstract: We propose two novel model architectures for computing continuous vector representations of words.

title: Exploring the Limits of Transfer Learning with a Unified Text-to-Text Transformer
abstract: We introduce the Text-to-Text Transfer Transformer (T5).
key_findings: Introduced T5, a unified text-to-text framework.

title: RoBERTa: A Robustly Optimized BERT Pretraining Approach
abstract: We present a replication study of BERT pretraining that carefully measures the impact of many key hyperparameters.
key_findings: Showed that BERT was undertrained and proposed better training methodologies.

title: Learning Transferable Visual Models From Natural Language Supervision
abstract: We demonstrate that simple pre-training of image-text pairs produces representations that generalize well.

title: An Image is Worth 16x16 Words: Transformers for Image Recognition at Scale
abstract: We show that pure transformers applied directly to image patches can perform very well.

title: Generative Adversarial Networks
abstract: We propose a new framework for estimating generative models via an adversarial process.

title: PointNet: Deep Learning on Point Sets for 3D Classification and Segmentation
abstract: We design a novel type of neural network that directly consumes point clouds.

title: Mask R-CNN
abstract: We present a conceptually simple, flexible, and general framework for object instance segmentation.
key_findings: Extended Faster R-CNN with a branch for predicting object masks.

title: U-Net: Convolutional Networks for Biomedical Image Segmentation
abstract: We present a network and training strategy that relies on the strong use of data augmentation.

title: High-Resolution Image Synthesis with Latent Diffusion Models
abstract: Diffusion models applied in the latent space of powerful pretrained autoencoders.

title: Auto-Encoding Variational Bayes
abstract: We introduce a stochastic variational inference and learning algorithm.

title: Mastering the game of Go with deep neural networks and tree search
abstract: We present AlphaGo, combining deep learning with Monte Carlo tree search.

title: Playing Atari with Deep Reinforcement Learning
abstract: We present the first deep learning model to successfully learn control policies directly from high-dimensional sensory input.

title: Proximal Policy Optimization Algorithms
abstract: We propose a new family of policy gradient methods for reinforcement learning.

title: Batch Normalization: Accelerating Deep Network Training by Reducing Internal Covariate Shift
abstract: We introduce a mechanism to normalize layer inputs.

title: Adam: A Method for Stochastic Optimization
abstract: We introduce Adam, an algorithm for first-order gradient-based optimization.

title: Highly accurate protein structure prediction with AlphaFold
abstract: We present AlphaFold, which predicts protein structures with remarkable accuracy.

title: Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models
abstract: We study empirical scaling laws for language model performance.

title: ELMo: Deep contextualized word representations
abstract: We introduce a new type of deep contextualized word representation.

title: GPT-4 Technical Report
abstract: We report the development of GPT-4.

title: RoFormer: Enhanced Transformer with Rotary Position Embedding
abstract: We propose a novel method named Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE).

title: Semi-Supervised Classification with Graph Convolutional Networks
abstract: We present a scalable approach for semi-supervised learning on graph-structured data.

title: Graph Attention Networks
abstract: We present graph attention networks (GATs).

title: Chain-of-Thought Prompting Elicits Reasoning in Large Language Models
abstract: We explore how generating a chain of thought improves LLM reasoning.
key_findings: Showed Chain-of-Thought prompting drastically improves reasoning.

title: Direct Preference Optimization: Your Language Model is Secretly a Reward Model
abstract: We propose Direct Preference Optimization (DPO).
key_findings: Introduced DPO as a stable alternative to RLHF.

title: CodeXGLUE: A Machine Learning Benchmark Dataset for Code Understanding and Generation
abstract: We present CodeXGLUE, a benchmark dataset for machine learning on programming languages.
key_findings: Introduced a benchmark for code tasks.

title: Deep Learning for Software Engineering: A Systematic Literature Review
abstract: A review of the intersection of deep learning and software engineering.
authors: Timo D. B. B. N. Santos

title: CodeBERT: A Pre-Trained Model for Programming and Natural Languages
abstract: We present CodeBERT, a bimodal pre-trained model for programming language (PL) and natural language (NL).

title: Explaining and Harnessing Adversarial Examples
abstract: We propose the fast gradient sign method to generate adversarial examples.

title: Towards Deep Learning Models Resistant to Adversarial Attacks
abstract: We study the adversarial robustness of neural networks.

title: Membership Inference Attacks Against Machine Learning Models
abstract: We investigate how models leak information about training data.

title: Deep Learning with Differential Privacy
abstract: We develop new algorithmic techniques for learning with differential privacy.

title: Communication-Efficient Learning of Deep Networks from Decentralized Data
abstract: We introduce Federated Learning.

title: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models
abstract: We present ReAct, combining reasoning traces and actions.

title: Soft Actor-Critic: Off-Policy Maximum Entropy Deep Reinforcement Learning
abstract: We introduce Soft Actor-Critic, an off-policy actor-critic algorithm.

title: Continuous control with deep reinforcement learning
abstract: We adapt Deep Q-Learning to the continuous action domain.

title: Database Tuning using Machine Learning
abstract: We survey recent advances in using machine learning to automate database tuning.

title: The Case for Learned Index Structures
abstract: We show that learned indexes can outperform traditional index structures.

title: Wasserstein GAN
abstract: We introduce WGAN, which improves GAN stability.

title: Image-to-Image Translation with Conditional Adversarial Networks
abstract: We investigate conditional adversarial networks as a general-purpose solution to image-to-image translation.

title: Unpaired Image-to-Image Translation using Cycle-Consistent Adversarial Networks
abstract: We present an approach for learning to translate an image in the absence of paired examples.

title: A Style-Based Generator Architecture for Generative Adversarial Networks
abstract: We propose a style-based generator architecture for GANs.

title: Image as a Foreign Language: BEiT Pretraining for All Vision Tasks
abstract: We introduce a masked image modeling task to pretrain vision transformers.

title: Masked Autoencoders Are Scalable Vision Learners
abstract: We show that masked autoencoders are scalable self-supervised learners.

title: InstructBLIP: Towards General-purpose Vision-Language Models with Instruction Tuning
abstract: We present InstructBLIP.
key_findings: Applied instruction tuning to vision-language models.

title: FlashAttention: Fast and Memory-Efficient Exact Attention with IO-Awareness
abstract: We propose FlashAttention, an IO-aware exact attention algorithm.

title: QLoRA: Efficient Finetuning of Quantized LLMs
abstract: We present QLoRA, an efficient finetuning approach.

title: Neural Collaborative Filtering
abstract: We explore deep learning for collaborative filtering.

title: Wide & Deep Learning for Recommender Systems
abstract: We present Wide & Deep learning.

title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks
abstract: We explore models that combine pre-trained parametric and non-parametric memory.

title: Neural Architecture Search with Reinforcement Learning
abstract: We present Neural Architecture Search.

title: Universal Language Model Fine-tuning for Text Classification
abstract: We propose ULMFiT, an effective transfer learning method.

title: Faster R-CNN: Towards Real-Time Object Detection with Region Proposal Networks
abstract: We introduce a Region Proposal Network.

title: SSD: Single Shot MultiBox Detector
abstract: We present a method for detecting objects in images using a single deep neural network.

title: You Only Look Once: Unified, Real-Time Object Detection
abstract: We present YOLO, a new approach to object detection.

title: Show and Tell: A Neural Image Caption Generator
abstract: We present a generative model based on a deep recurrent architecture for image captioning.

title: Billion-scale similarity search with GPUs
abstract: We introduce Faiss, a library for efficient similarity search.

title: Swish: a Self-Gated Activation Function
abstract: We propose a new activation function, Swish.

title: Layer Normalization
abstract: We introduce layer normalization.

title: Very Deep Convolutional Networks for Large-Scale Image Recognition
abstract: We investigate the effect of the convolutional network depth on its accuracy.

title: Longformer: The Long-Document Transformer
abstract: We introduce Longformer with an attention mechanism that scales linearly with sequence length.

title: GraphSAGE: Inductive Representation Learning on Large Graphs
abstract: We present GraphSAGE, a general inductive framework.

title: EfficientNet: Rethinking Model Scaling for Convolutional Neural Networks
abstract: We propose a new scaling method that uniformly scales all dimensions of depth/width/resolution.

title: Deep Graph InfoMax
abstract: We introduce Deep Graph Infomax (DGI).

title: Swin Transformer: Hierarchical Vision Transformer using Shifted Windows
abstract: We present Swin Transformer.

title: A ConvNet for the 2020s
abstract: We explore the design spaces and test the limits of what a pure ConvNet can achieve.

title: Transformer-XL: Attentive Language Models Beyond a Fixed-Length Context
abstract: We propose Transformer-XL.

title: Switch Transformers: Scaling to Trillion Parameter Models with Simple and Efficient Sparsity
abstract: We present Switch Transformers.

title: REALM: Retrieval-Augmented Language Model Pre-training
abstract: We introduce a novel framework REALM.

title: DeBERTa: Decoding-enhanced BERT with Disentangled Attention
abstract: We propose DeBERTa.

title: Deep contextualized word representations
abstract: We introduce a new type of deep contextualized word representation.

title: Self-Normalizing Neural Networks
abstract: We introduce self-normalizing neural networks (SNNs).

title: MobileNets: Efficient Convolutional Neural Networks for Mobile Vision Applications
abstract: We present a class of efficient models called MobileNets.

title: MobileNetV2: Inverted Residuals and Linear Bottlenecks
abstract: We describe a new mobile architecture, MobileNetV2.

title: Pre-trained Models for Natural Language Processing: A Survey
abstract: We provide a comprehensive review of PTMs for NLP.

title: DALL-E: Zero-Shot Text-to-Image Generation
abstract: We train a 12-billion parameter autoregressive transformer on text-image pairs.

title: Hierarchical Text-Conditional Image Generation with CLIP Latents
abstract: We propose a two-stage model for text-to-image generation.

title: Photorealistic Text-to-Image Diffusion Models with Deep Language Understanding
abstract: We present Imagen, a text-to-image diffusion model.

title: BART: Denoising Sequence-to-Sequence Pre-training for Natural Language Generation
abstract: We present BART, a denoising autoencoder for pretraining sequence-to-sequence models.

title: Cross-lingual Language Model Pretraining
abstract: We propose two methods to learn cross-lingual language models.

title: HuggingFace's Transformers: State-of-the-art Natural Language Processing
abstract: We present Transformers, an open-source library.

title: Deep Reinforcement Learning that Matters
abstract: We investigate the reproducibility of deep reinforcement learning.

title: Reformer: The Efficient Transformer
abstract: We introduce the Reformer.

title: Dueling Network Architectures for Deep Reinforcement Learning
abstract: We present a new neural network architecture for model-free reinforcement learning.

title: Focal Loss for Dense Object Detection
abstract: We propose to reshape the standard cross entropy loss.

title: Distributed Representations of Sentences and Documents
abstract: We propose an unsupervised algorithm that learns fixed-length feature representations from variable-length pieces of texts.

title: Grid-based Methods for Deep Reinforcement Learning
abstract: We survey grid-based methods in DRL.

title: Perceiver: General Perception with Iterative Attention
abstract: We introduce the Perceiver.

title: FaceNet: A Unified Embedding for Face Recognition and Clustering
abstract: We present a system, called FaceNet.

title: Sequential Short-Text Classification with Recurrent and Convolutional Neural Networks
abstract: We present a model for sequential short-text classification.
